HOME SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Hygiene and Safety? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Hygiene and Safety.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Hygiene and Safety.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Food Hygiene and Safety.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Hygiene and Safety.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene ? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Housing the Family? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Housing the Family.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Housing the Family.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Housing the Family.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Housing the Family.

5. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

6. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Paper burning to ash

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutritive Value of Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutritive Value of Foods.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Nutritive Value of Foods.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutritive Value of Foods.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutritive Value of Foods.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Kitchen Layouts and Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Overview of Home Science? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Overview of Home Science.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Overview of Home Science.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Overview of Home Science.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Overview of Home Science.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in ? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .

11. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers

13. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Methods of Cooking? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Methods of Cooking.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Methods of Cooking.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Methods of Cooking.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Methods of Cooking.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.

16. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
